description: One-click OBS image desensitization skill for Huawei Cloud. Lists images in an OBS bucket/prefix, applies desensitization rules (full-image mosaic, Gaussian blur, region mosaic/blur/occlusion) locally via Pillow, and writes results back to a target bucket/prefix; optionally creates a FunctionGraph function + OBS event trigger for automatic on-upload desensitization. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) desensitize/blur/mosaic images stored in OBS, (2) batch mosaic or blur all images under a bucket prefix, (3) occlude sensitive regions (faces, license plates, IDs) in OBS images, (4) set up automatic image desensitization when files are uploaded to an OBS bucket. Triggers include: "OBS图片脱敏", "图片打码", "图片马赛克", "图片模糊", "人脸打码", "敏感区域遮挡", "OBS图片一键脱敏", "批量打码", "自动脱敏", "image desensitization", "mosaic image in OBS", "blur OBS images", "auto desensitize uploads", "打码", "脱敏"
